comment: The panel calls this module DEAD MEAT; the slug is DialecticFilter and the widget loads res/panels/DeadMeat.svg. The panel prints FREQ, BITE, RESO, BIAS, A/B for the mode switch and NORMALLED CV IN across the jack block; the flip output is lettered O and the maker names it Flips. The Bias control voltage is added to the knob at full scale with no division and no clamp, where the resonance voltage is divided by ten first. Bypassing the module passes the audio input to the audio output.
